phases.name: Year 1
phases.subtitle: Explore
phases.description: Computing Foundations & Algorithmic Thinking — Build programming skills, explore CS careers, and develop computational reasoning.

milestones.label: Explore computer science career pathways
milestones.description: Survey of computer science including software engineering, AI/ML, cybersecurity, data science, game development, and systems programming. Students complete introductory programming projects in Python.

milestones.label: Master object-oriented programming
milestones.description: Object-oriented programming in Java or C++ including classes, inheritance, polymorphism, and exception handling. Students build progressively complex programs with proper software engineering practices.

milestones.label: Build discrete mathematics foundations
milestones.description: Logic, set theory, combinatorics, graph theory, and proof techniques. The mathematical foundation for algorithm design, data structures, and theoretical computer science.

milestones.label: Join ACM student chapter or coding community
milestones.description: Join the ACM student chapter, NSBE, Google Developer Student Club, or campus coding club. Participate in hackathons, coding challenges, and tech meetups.

milestones.label: Build calculus foundations for computing
milestones.description: Functions, limits, derivatives, and integration. Mathematical foundation for algorithms, machine learning, graphics, and computational theory.

phases.name: Year 2
phases.subtitle: Engage
phases.description: Data Structures & Systems Programming — Master core CS concepts and build software engineering skills.

milestones.label: Master data structures and algorithms
milestones.description: Arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, hash tables, graphs, and algorithm complexity analysis. Students implement data structures from scratch and solve algorithm problems.

milestones.label: Study computer organization and architecture
milestones.description: Digital logic, CPU architecture, memory hierarchy, instruction sets, and assembly language programming. Students understand how software executes on hardware.

milestones.label: Compete in ACM programming competition
milestones.description: Represent NC A&T in the ACM International Collegiate Programming Contest (ICPC) regional competition. Develop algorithmic problem-solving speed and team programming skills.

milestones.label: Master operating systems concepts
milestones.description: Process management, memory management, file systems, concurrency, and system calls. Students write systems programs in C and analyze Linux kernel behavior.

milestones.label: Study software engineering principles
milestones.description: Software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum), requirements engineering, testing, version control (Git), and CI/CD. Students complete a team-based software project.

phases.name: Year 3
phases.subtitle: Develop
phases.description: Advanced CS Specialization & Professional Experience — Master advanced topics, build a portfolio, and complete internship.

milestones.label: Master database systems design
milestones.description: Relational database theory, SQL, normalization, query optimization, NoSQL databases, and distributed data systems. Students design and implement a full-stack database application.

milestones.label: Study artificial intelligence and machine learning
milestones.description: Search algorithms, knowledge representation, machine learning fundamentals, neural networks, and natural language processing. Students implement AI algorithms and train ML models on real datasets.

milestones.label: Contribute to open-source project or research lab
milestones.description: Make meaningful contributions to an open-source software project or join a faculty research lab in AI, cybersecurity, or systems. Build a public portfolio of technical contributions.

milestones.label: Complete summer software engineering internship
milestones.description: Secure and complete an internship at a tech company, startup, or research lab. Apply software engineering, AI, or systems skills in a professional environment.

milestones.label: Study computer networks and cybersecurity
milestones.description: TCP/IP, network protocols, routing, network security, and distributed systems. Students configure networks, analyze packet captures, and implement security measures.

phases.name: Year 4
phases.subtitle: Launch
phases.description: Capstone Project & Career Launch — Complete senior project, build portfolio, and launch CS career.

milestones.label: Execute senior capstone software project
milestones.description: Complete a year-long software development project addressing a real-world problem. Teams follow Agile methodology, produce working software, and present to faculty and industry reviewers.

milestones.label: Prepare for technical interviews and certifications
milestones.description: Intensive preparation for technical coding interviews including LeetCode practice, system design questions, and behavioral interview training. Explore AWS, Google Cloud, or security certifications.

milestones.label: Serve as peer mentor and tech community leader
milestones.description: Mentor underclassmen in CS coursework, lead ACM chapter activities, and organize hackathons, coding workshops, and tech career panels.

milestones.label: Develop tech career placement portfolio
milestones.description: Assemble a career launch package including GitHub portfolio, technical resume, project demos, open-source contributions, and documented professional network.

milestones.label: Complete exit assessment and career activation
milestones.description: Complete the CoE Computer Science Exit Assessment demonstrating ABET outcomes. Finalize career activation documenting job offers, graduate admissions, or certification achievements.
